cands.name: Maria Cervania
cands.bio: Democrat and epidemiologist/biostatistician representing NC House District 41 (western Wake County) since 2023. Previously a Wake County Commissioner (2020–2022). Worked in public health and state-agency program analysis, including Texas-style agency performance and research roles, and is a former research epidemiologist.

endorsements.text: Sierra Club North Carolina endorsed her in the 2026 general election, per Ballotpedia.

cands.gaps: We could not find the year she moved to North Carolina. The pages we had show no bills she sponsored or other specific actions in office, so we could not document what she did on data centers, homestead property taxes, investor or foreign land buying, immigration enforcement, policing, guns, abortion or school choice. We found no stated positions from her on data centers, homestead taxes, immigration, guns, abortion or school vouchers. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022, 2024 or 2026; her 2020 survey was for the county commission race. Her campaign site's growth and land statements come from an undated page apparently written for her 2022 campaign.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Held the Wake County Board of Commissioners District 3 seat (2020–2022) and has served in the NC House since 2023. Career as a biostatistician/consultant, performance management analyst and project manager for state health and human services programs, research project manager in a court administration office, and university epidemiologist.
qual.why: Prior local and state legislative service plus policy, budget-efficiency and analytic career work fit the high band for writing law and the state budget.
qual.label: Prior local and state legislative service plus policy, budget-efficiency and analytic career work fit the high band for writing law and the state budget.

slow-growth-protect-land.evidence: Her campaign site says she will fight for protection of farmland, open space and greenways and advocates for balanced growth.

land_positions.quote_or_summary: Campaign site says she will advocate for 'balanced growth' and fight for 'protection of our farmland, open space, and greenways'; she describes wanting to be 'conscientious about how' growth occurs.

cands.name: Bruce Forster
cands.bio: Bruce Forster is a Republican who ran for the North Carolina House of Representatives in District 41 in 2022 and 2026, losing both general elections to incumbent Democrat Maria Cervania. No other career or office history was found.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Bruce Forster was born or raised, when he moved to North Carolina, or his occupation and work history. He has held no elected office, so there is no record of official actions. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and we found no campaign platform, interviews or questionnaires stating his positions on any issue. We found no public statements on data centers or development, no documented controversies and no notable endorsements.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: The only documented history is two unsuccessful candidacies for NC House District 41, in 2022 and 2026. Neither his occupation nor any office held was found.
